reduction.group: all channels pooled with exact valid waveform-sample weights, including partial cells
reduction.mel: valid elements pooled per resolution, then resolutions averaged
reduction.nonquiet_cosine: equal-source mean over only active teacher-conditioned20ms windows
reduction.nrmse: root mean-square error divided by teacher RMS, teacher mean-square floor1e-8 explicitly flagged
reduction.quiet_residual: RMS of sample-pooled quiet squared residual
